user_story: As a user, I want to submit a contact form on the Automation Exercise website so that I can provide feedback or ask questions. The form should validate the inputs and provide appropriate feedback for successful and unsuccessful submissions.
cypress_script: describe('Contact Us Form', () => { it('should submit the contact form successfully with valid inputs', () => { cy.visit('https://automationexercise.com/contact_us'); cy.get('input[name="name"]').type('John Doe'); cy.get('input[name="email"]').type('john.doe@example.com'); cy.get('input[name="subject"]').type('Inquiry'); cy.get('textarea#message').type('This is a test message.'); cy.get('input[name="submit"]').click(); cy.get('#success-subscribe').should('contain.text', 'You have been successfully subscribed!'); }); it('should show an error when the email is invalid', () => { cy.visit('https://automationexercise.com/contact_us'); cy.get('input[name="name"]').type('John Doe'); cy.get('input[name="email"]').type('invalid-email'); cy.get('input[name="subject"]').type('Inquiry'); cy.get('textarea#message').type('This is a test message.'); cy.get('input[name="submit"]').click(); cy.get('#success-subscribe').should('not.exist'); }); });
playwright_script: import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'; test('Contact Us Form', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://automationexercise.com/contact_us'); await page.fill('input[name="name"]', 'John Doe'); await page.fill('input[name="email"]', 'john.doe@example.com'); await page.fill('input[name="subject"]', 'Inquiry'); await page.fill('textarea#message', 'This is a test message.'); await page.click('input[name="submit"]'); await expect(page.locator('#success-subscribe')).toContainText('You have been successfully subscribed!'); await page.goto('https://automationexercise.com/contact_us'); await page.fill('input[name="name"]', 'John Doe'); await page.fill('input[name="email"]', 'invalid-email'); await page.fill('input[name="subject"]', 'Inquiry'); await page.fill('textarea#message', 'This is a test message.'); await page.click('input[name="submit"]'); await expect(page.locator('#success-subscribe')).not.toBeVisible(); });
